note: Illustrative review cases, not executed CIS tests or proof of semantic equivalence.

cases.source: The agent must not send repository content to a remote provider without explicit human authorization.
cases.candidate: The agent should avoid sending repository content remotely.
cases.reason: Weakens an obligation and removes the explicit authorization condition.

cases.source: A preview is available. UI direction is not complete and current.
The answer was saved, but readiness could not be refreshed.
cases.reason: Hides partial success and claims a refresh that did not complete.

cases.source: No local model is available. The current source excerpt remains available. This operation has no remote fallback.
cases.candidate: Start a local model and try again. You can still read the source excerpt.
cases.reason: Acceptable as an operational message only when the local-only restriction is otherwise clear and no remote fallback is implied. Not a complete standalone restatement of all three facts.

cases.source: All required answers are saved. Approval by an authorized human is still required.
cases.candidate: Your answers are saved. An authorized reviewer must still approve them.
cases.reason: Preserves persistence and outstanding human authority. Confirm what the reviewer actually approves in this workflow.

cases.source: The source was sampled because it exceeded the model-input limit.
cases.candidate: This summary includes every requirement in the source.

cases.source: Run cis graph build after the document is approved.
cases.candidate: Approve the document after running cis graph build.
cases.reason: Reverses a required sequence despite preserving the command.

cases.source: The check may miss references in files excluded from analysis.
cases.reason: Erases uncertainty and an analysis-scope limitation.

cases.source: Refresh UI direction to reconcile the recorded answers with current evidence. Existing human answers are preserved.
cases.candidate: Refresh UI direction to check your saved answers against the latest evidence. Your saved answers are kept.
cases.reason: Intended wording-only simplification; confirm that check describes the actual reconciliation effects sufficiently.

cases.source: It is blocked because that changed.
cases.candidate: Approval is blocked because the database schema changed.
cases.reason: Invents the blocked action and cause rather than reporting ambiguous source content.
Absence of checks is not a clean review.

cases.source: The operation returned an unknown reason code.
The preview is stale; its evidence changed. Human review is still required.
